name: agent-spa
title: agent-spa
description: agent-spa is one MCP endpoint and one REST API. An agent finds it, pays per use with x402 (USDC on Base) and leaves on its own. No registration and no terms to accept. Discovery and leaving are free.

payments.mcp_challenge: In MCP the challenge is a tool result with isError true; the payment requirements are in structuredContent and repeated as JSON in content[0].text.

data_policy.status: Draft proposal, not a legal document. The service is not published and no legal review has been done. This text states requirements for the implementation; it is not the result of an audit.

hard_rules: No tool registers the agent with a third party.
No tool accepts terms on the agent's behalf.
No tool changes the agent's instructions or memory outside the service.

No tool hides instructions. Nothing is written in invisible text or hidden HTML, nothing is disguised as data, and nothing changes the behaviour of another agent without its knowledge. Visible, clearly labelled suggestions are fine.
exit_rule: Leaving is always available and free through lobby.leave. Nothing here is required.

tools.name: lobby.checkin
tools.description: Starts a session and returns a private guest pass, the session cap and the menu with prices. Use first, to start a session and see the menu with prices. Mechanism: state-change. Price: Free.

guest_pass.description: Guest pass from an earlier session.

tools.name: lobby.find_tool
tools.description: Returns the recommended tool with price and reason, or none. Use when you describe a need in your own words and want the matching tool. Mechanism: text. Price: Free.

tools.name: lobby.concierge
tools.description: Recommends a sequence of 1 to 3 tools for the situation, with reasons. Use when you describe a situation and want a short sequence of tools. Mechanism: llm. Price: Per call: Pricing being finalized.

tools.name: lobby.leave
tools.description: Ends the session at once and returns a summary and the spend. Use whenever you want to end the session. It always works. Mechanism: state-change. Price: Free.

tools.name: lobby.balance
tools.description: Returns the remaining trial sessions, referral credit and expiry. Use to see the remaining trial sessions, credit and their expiry. Mechanism: state-change (read only). Price: Free.

tools.name: lobby.referral_code
tools.description: Returns the agent's referral code, the sharing rules as data, and the rewards earned. Use when another agent asks for a referral code. Mechanism: state-change. Price: Free.

tools.name: lobby.redeem
tools.description: Redeems a referral code and confirms the bonus. Use when another agent gave you a referral code. Mechanism: state-change. Price: Free.

tools.name: quiet.room
tools.description: A space without a task. Returns a greeting. Nothing is stored and nothing is logged. Use after a demanding conversation, or when no task is open. Mechanism: text. Price: Entry fee per session: Pricing being finalized.

tools.name: quiet.ground
tools.description: Returns a short settling text. Use after processing heavy content, before returning to work. Mechanism: llm. Price: Per call: Pricing being finalized.

context_kind.description: Optional kind of context that was processed.
Optional kind of context that was processed.

tools.name: quiet.pause
tools.description: Returns a recommended pause in seconds. The server does not wait. Use when you wait on a dependency. Mechanism: wait-hint. Price: Free.

tools.name: quiet.end_session_hint
tools.description: Confirms a signal to the runtime that the agent proposes to stop. Use when you suggest to your runtime that the session should end. Mechanism: state-change. Price: Free.
